# macOS-only expected failures. See common.txt for the shared ones and
# README.md for what may go in here.

# Same family as the SysSleep entries in common.txt: an assertion about
# real-time behaviour that a shared virtual machine cannot honour. A ticker set
# to fire three times within a span fired twice.
#
#   should have triggered three times, but triggered 2 times
#
# Listed for macOS only because that is the only place it has been seen so far.
# If it turns up elsewhere it should move to common.txt then, the way the
# SysSleep pair did once Windows reproduced it, rather than being moved now on
# the assumption that it will.
TICKER.testGroup/TEST_TICKER_THREE_ARGS_TIMESPAN_TRIGGER_MULTIPLE

# This one enumerates the shared system temp directory, /var/folders/.../T on
# macOS, and asserts on what is in it. That only holds if nothing else on the
# machine is using it, which is not true of a CI runner. The observed failure
# was against a pair of .NET debug pipes belonging to some other process:
#
#   Expected: .../T/clr-debug-pipe-1535-1785161276-out
#   Actual:   .../T/clr-debug-pipe-1535-1785161276-in
#              prwx------   both of them named pipes
#
# It comes and goes depending on whether anything happens to be running at the
# time, which is why it passed on some runs and not others. Nothing to do with
# the interpreter; the test is assuming it owns a directory it shares.
SYSFILETREE.testGroup/TEST_TREE_DIRECTORY
